# Loghub-2k samples

Gzipped copies of the 2,000-line Loghub-2k samples for the 14 datasets annotated in Loghub-2.0,
taken from https://github.com/logpai/loghub-2.0 (`2k_dataset/`). Each `*_2k.log.gz` is the raw
log; each `*_2k.log_structured.csv.gz` keeps only the `LineId` and `EventTemplate` columns of the
published ground truth. They are redistributed under the Loghub license in `LICENSE.txt`.

Cite: Jieming Zhu, Shilin He, Pinjia He, Jinyang Liu, Michael R. Lyu. Loghub: A Large Collection
of System Log Datasets for AI-driven Log Analytics. ISSRE 2023. Zhihan Jiang et al. A Large-scale
Evaluation for Log Parsing Techniques: How Far are We? ISSTA 2024.
